text:
The bug is in `grid/spiral.py`: when the matrix has only one row, the "left along the bottom row" loop re-traverses the same row in reverse (and the "up the first column" loop hits the same row via a negative index). Similarly, for a single-column matrix, the "down the last column" loop re-traverses the same column. Square matrices hide this because all four sides are distinct.

Let me verify my understanding of the failing cases, then apply a minimal fix by guarding the bottom-row and left-column loops:
